summary.text: Travis Nelson is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado State Senate District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works in agriculture and was the Democratic candidate for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Travis Nelson earned a high school diploma from John Mall High School and a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University Pueblo in 2002.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in rural southern Colorado, comes from a ranch family, and is a father and small-business owner.
Nelson was the Democratic candidate for Colorado State Senate District 35 in 2022 and lost the general election to Rodney Pelton, 74.3 percent to 25.7 percent.
In 2026 he is running without a party affiliation; he said in his survey that he believes a state senator should not answer first to a political party.
Nelson's key campaign messages, as he listed them, were people before party, relentless representation and rural Colorado priorities.
He named water, agriculture, healthcare, public safety, education, infrastructure, affordable housing, small business and jobs among the issues he would focus on.
